420 white students enrolled at Richard C. Hedke Elementary School in 2024-25
Richard C. Hedke Elementary School had 420 white students in the 2024-25 school year, an increase of 1.7% from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
The school enrolled 541 students in the 2024-25 school year. White students comprised 77.6% of the student body, the largest ethnicity at the school.
The school is part of Trenton Public Schools District, whose central office is in Trenton.
Of the four schools in Trenton Public Schools District, Trenton High School had the largest number of white students in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, including $19.5 billion from the School Aid Fund. It set per-pupil funding at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. The budget maintained free school meals and included full funding for pre-K and community college.
